newsitem.title: CHINA: China Southern Glass in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: China Southern Glass in rights issue.

text.p: China Southern Glass Holdings Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would make a 1.935-for-10 rights offer to raise net proceeds of 385 million yuan for expansion of its core business.
The offer, based on 507.1 million outstanding shares, has been priced at 4.00 yuan per rights share, the company said in a prospectus in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The registration deadline for the company's foreign-currency B shares is July 25, and the B shares will go ex-rights on July 23, the prospectus said.
Everbright Securities Co is the main underwriter for the issue, said the glass maker, which is based in the southern city of Shenzhen.
